sql_top_region.sql: WITH "__m0" AS (SELECT "sales_orders"."region" AS "__d0", SUM("sales_orders"."sales_amount") AS "__value" FROM "sales_orders" WHERE "sales_orders"."order_date" >= ? AND "sales_orders"."order_date" < ? GROUP BY "sales_orders"."region"), "__keys" AS (SELECT "__d0" FROM "__m0"), "__combined" AS (SELECT "__keys"."__d0" AS "region", "__m0"."__value" AS "销售额" FROM "__keys" LEFT JOIN "__m0" ON "__keys"."__d0" IS "__m0"."__d0"), "__ranked" AS (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "销售额" DESC) AS "__rank" FROM "__combined") SELECT "region", "销售额", "__rank" AS "排名" FROM "__ranked" WHERE "__rank" <= ? ORDER BY "销售额" DESC, "region" LIMIT ?
